outputContract: ECharts blocks must be strict RFC 8259 JSON (a pure ECharts option object)
Do not output comments, trailing commas, undefined, NaN, Infinity, or functions
All keys must use double quotes; all string values must use double quotes
Never output callback expressions such as (params) => ... or function (...)
The top-level object IS the ECharts option — do not wrap it in {option: ...}
Must contain a "series" array; each series object must have a "type" field
Supported series types: map, sankey, tree, treemap, sunburst, candlestick, gauge, themeRiver, wordCloud, bar3D, scatter3D
Include realistic, descriptive data values — not placeholder numbers
Do not set color arrays — the renderer applies a curated palette automatically
Do not set textStyle.color, axisLine.lineStyle.color, or tooltip styles -- the renderer applies theme-aware styles automatically for both light and dark modes
For map charts, use "map": "china" or "map": "world" in series — geoJSON is registered by the renderer

chartTypes.name: Sankey Diagram / 桑基图
chartTypes.description: Flow/allocation visualization: budgets, energy flow, user journeys, supply chains
chartTypes.notes: series[].data is an array of {name} nodes. series[].links has {source, target, value}. Link source/target must match node names exactly.

chartTypes.name: Tree / 树图
chartTypes.description: Hierarchical tree structures: org charts, file trees, decision trees
chartTypes.notes: Data uses nested {name, children:[...]} structure. Set layout margins (top/left/bottom/right) for proper spacing.

chartTypes.name: Treemap / 矩形树图
chartTypes.description: Proportional hierarchical data: disk usage, market cap, budget breakdown
chartTypes.notes: Leaf nodes must have a value field. Set leafDepth for drill-down levels. Use upperLabel for parent category headers.

chartTypes.name: Sunburst / 旭日图
chartTypes.description: Multi-level proportional data: revenue by region/product, nested category breakdowns
chartTypes.notes: Leaf nodes must have value. Set radius [inner, outer] for sizing. Use label.rotate:'radial' for readability.

chartTypes.name: Candlestick / K线图
chartTypes.description: Stock/financial K-line charts, OHLC data visualization
chartTypes.notes: Each data item is [open, close, lowest, highest]. Always set yAxis.scale:true for proper range. Use category xAxis for date labels.

chartTypes.name: Advanced Gauge / 高级仪表盘
chartTypes.description: Advanced gauges with progress bars, custom ranges, multi-pointer dashboards
chartTypes.notes: Data is array of {name, value}. Default range is 0-100; set min/max for custom ranges. Use progress.show for modern gauge style.

chartTypes.name: Theme River / 主题河流
chartTypes.description: Trends of multiple categories over time as stacked streams
chartTypes.notes: Data is array of [date, value, categoryName] triples. Requires singleAxis config. Ensure consistent date points across all categories.

chartTypes.name: Geographic Map / 地图
chartTypes.description: Geographic choropleth maps for regional data visualization
chartTypes.notes: Only 'china' and 'world' maps are registered. For china map, use Chinese province names (e.g., '北京', '上海'). Always include visualMap for choropleth coloring.

chartTypes.name: Word Cloud / 词云
chartTypes.description: Word frequency visualization where size represents importance or frequency
chartTypes.notes: REQUIRES echarts-wordcloud extension. shape: 'circle', 'cardioid', 'diamond', 'triangle', 'star'. sizeRange controls [min, max] font size.

chartTypes.name: 3D Bar Chart / 3D柱状图
chartTypes.description: Three-dimensional bar chart for spatial data or multi-dimension comparison
chartTypes.notes: REQUIRES echarts-gl extension. Data format: [xIndex, yIndex, value]. Use grid3D.viewControl.autoRotate for rotation effect.

chartTypes.name: 3D Scatter Chart / 3D散点图
chartTypes.description: Three-dimensional scatter plot for 3-variable spatial data
chartTypes.notes: REQUIRES echarts-gl extension. Data format: [x, y, z]. Use symbolSize for point size.
